╭─ You're using your ChatGPT plan ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ This session spends your ChatGPT plan's allowance, not API credit. A Plus plan shares one five-hour allowance across every │
│ app that uses it, ChatGPT included.                                                                                        │
│ Usage is shown and managed at https://chatgpt.com/settings/usage.                                                          │
